purpose: Extend and verify official/institutional secondary research for Sud-Vest Oltenia, Sud-Muntenia and Centru without converting historical employer surveys, project activity, funding supply or benchmark indicators into AI4WORK need-prevalence claims.

registry_reconciliation.issue_detected: The 00:32 control refresh labelled the EC Regional Innovation Scoreboard 2025 Romania profile as a new S41, but the controlled Drive Source_register already contained the same source and URL as S27 and contained no S41 row.
registry_reconciliation.resolution: Treat the earlier S41 label as a duplicate candidate that was not persisted to the controlled Source_register. Preserve S27 as the RIS source and allocate the next actual registry row S41 to the newly verified AJOFM Arges employer survey.

promoted_source.title: Prognoza angajarilor pe termen scurt - Judetul Arges (eSPOR)

observed_facts.method: online eight-question employer survey; quota sample with emphasis on employers with at least 10 employees; telephone/email assisted recruitment

promoted_source.source_interpretation: The official employer survey is useful as historical direct-complementary evidence that territorial labour-demand analysis can be built from a bounded employer instrument and as a methodological benchmark for employer sampling. It does not measure digital/AI skills need and does not support an AI4WORK prevalence or ranking claim.
limitations: County-level Arges evidence, not the whole Sud-Muntenia region.
Historical 2022 collection / 2023 forecast and not AI- or digital-skills-specific.
Quota sample and assisted contact, not a probability sample of all employers.
Hiring estimates and respondent composition are not converted into AI4WORK need prevalence.
No S41 value enters H1-H5 or changes the deterministic ranking before sufficient real primary AI4WORK evidence exists.

call_requirements_refresh.gmail_query_scope: after:2026/09/02 excluding spam/trash/GitHub; terms 367944, AI4WORK, OMIPE, MIPE, PEO, 1302, Anexa 4, eucons.ro, Claus, GDPR

refresh_conclusion: The controlled source register now has a real non-duplicate S41: AJOFM Arges eSPOR employer survey. S39 Covasna and S40 Olt were reverified against their official PDFs, giving one freshly checked employer-survey anchor in each target region while retaining zero H1-H5 weight because the surveys are historical and not AI/digital-skills-specific. The earlier EC RIS S41 candidate is reconciled as a duplicate of existing S27 and was never persisted to the controlled Source_register. No new authority/provider email or eligible immutable real adult+employer export changes the precollection boundary.
